components.semantic: Mean satisfaction of private allowed-value, set and numeric-tolerance constraints.
components.evidence: F1 of required evidence-group coverage and relevant evidence precision, with forbidden-domain penalties.
components.provenance: All submitted evidence refs must exist in MCP audit and match team, run and case.
components.consistency: Deterministic cross-field checks for status/refund/action, seller responsibility and duplicate actions.
components.calibration: One minus squared error between primary-issue correctness and submitted confidence.
components.workflow: Mean of lifecycle-event coverage, receive/finalize ordering, actor collaboration and evidence-to-trace linkage.
components.efficiency: Full credit through the private per-case call budget, then linear decay to zero at maximum calls; all MCP-audited calls count.

final_leaderboard.submission_selection: best score among team-selected final submissions for the competition

feedback_visibility.before_finalize: public-partition aggregate score and public component breakdown
feedback_visibility.after_finalize: weighted final score: 20% public partition and 80% private partition
